item.title: A look at two opposing perspectives on AI agent sandboxing: infosec says labs need better containment while AI alignment says sandboxes cannot contain agents
item.description: Matthew Green referees the infosec-vs-alignment debate on agent sandboxing, then adds his own third worry: a swarm of agents that never leave their sandboxes, each doing exactly what it was told by a human who wasn't supposed to be giving orders.
